input_images.role: edit target; preserve small human scale, pose and all scene geometry while changing clothing to computational physics researcher

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. The whole scene, composition and scale are approved. Make a VERY NARROW LOCAL EDIT ONLY TO THE EXISTING SMALL HUMAN FIGURE AND THEIR TABLET SCREEN.

The person is an adult computational scientist / physics researcher, not a consultant or business presenter. Change their clothing to relaxed research-work clothing: a simple dark navy casual crewneck knit top or soft rolled-sleeve shirt, casual charcoal trousers (not tailored suit trousers), and practical comfortable low-profile shoes. No blazer, no suit jacket, no tie, no business presentation styling. ABSOLUTELY NO WHITE LAB COAT. Preserve the existing adult figure's small height (approximately 22–25% of image height), body position, pose, pointing hand, tablet-holding hand, understated face and supporting role beside the agent. They are reviewing a computational physics model and quantum circuit constraints. On the existing tablet screen, add only a few extremely subtle scientific line marks suggesting a small matrix or physics plot; do not add readable words, new large graphics, or code walls. Their pointing gesture remains directed toward the existing specification panel with the phi/circuit symbols, indicating interaction about scientific requirements.

LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY: human scale and position, agent scale and appearance, the existing specification panel, all circuit cards and gates, red rejected-candidate X, all arrow geometry and directions, the large teal PROPOSE arrow, independent CHECK instrument and icon, broad vermilion REFINE return arrow, final small output circuit and substrate, all four exact labels "AI AGENT", "PROPOSE", "CHECK", "REFINE", warm off-white background, colors, lighting, material finish, camera, perspective, 16:9 aspect ratio. This must be the SAME IMAGE except that the small person reads as a casually dressed computational physics researcher. Do not redesign or recompose.

Avoid: white lab coat, any lab coat, beakers, goggles, wet laboratory props, stereotypical wild-haired genius styling, added people, larger human, portrait close-up, extra text, logos, numerical performance claims, new devices, additional decorative objects.

export.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS, ImageOps.fit center crop; approximately 0.06% vertical crop to 16:9

conceptual_status: Conceptual editorial illustration of a computational physics researcher interacting with a software agent and independent tools; no experimental measurement or actual QPU performance is represented.

mobile_preview_inspected.result: The small navy-clad researcher remains visible as a supporting figure pointing at the scientific specification panel; AI AGENT, CHECK and REFINE remain readable.

criteria: Researcher wears a simple dark navy casual crewneck top with relaxed charcoal trousers; no suit jacket, tie, white coat or laboratory coat.
Tablet and pointing gesture are preserved; subtle tablet marks suggest scientific review without new readable text.
Existing phi/circuit specification panel continues to establish physics and circuit research context.
Human scale, pose and position remain comparable to v3.
Agent, three candidates, rejected middle candidate, independent checker, four labels and directional proposal/refine loop are preserved.
Camera, palette, warm off-white materials and 16:9 composition remain visually stable.
limitations: At thumbnail size, clothing is visible but very small tablet details are intentionally not readable.
No clothing or visual cue uniquely identifies a research specialty; scientific role is conveyed by the surrounding phi/circuit panel and computational workflow.
Circuit symbols and revisions are conceptual, not executable circuits or proof of measured performance.
